name: potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 5

function.text: KCNH5 is the approved symbol for potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in delayed rectifier potassium channel activity; protein-containing complex binding; potassium ion transmembrane transport.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include neonatal/infantile epilepsy syndrome (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 112 (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
